pages.text: Utility items provide additional functionality beyond the core tool set.

pages.title: Tape Measure
pages.text:
Right-click to set the start point of a measurement.
Right-click again to set the end point and draw a measurement box with X/Y/Z length labels.
Shift+right-click to undo the last measurement point.

The tape measure is unbreakable and has no durability.

pages.title: Chunk Anchor & Anchor Tome
pages.text: Place a Chunk Anchor block, then right-click it with an Anchor Tome to insert the tome into its pedestal slot. While the tome is inserted, the chunk containing the anchor is force-loaded (kept active even with no players nearby), permanently and at no cost.$(br2)Right-click the anchor empty-handed (or while sneaking) to extract the tome back into your inventory and release the forced chunk. Breaking the anchor while a tome is inserted drops both items and releases the chunk immediately.$(br2)Only the single chunk containing the anchor is force-loaded, not a radius or neighboring chunks.

pages.title: Robust Stick
pages.text:
A crafting ingredient used in Expert and Professional grade tools (tiers 3-4).

Has no durability as it's only used as a crafting component.
